exposure: serum apolipoprotein levels in early pregnancy (ApoA-I, ApoA-II, ApoA-IV, ApoB, ApoC-I, ApoC-II, ApoC-III, ApoD, ApoE, ApoH, ApoJ, ApoM)
cohort: The study included 991 pregnant women from the population-based Odense Child Cohort.
finding: High levels of ApoB and low levels of ApoD in early pregnancy were independently associated with an increased risk of GDM, insulin resistance, and large-for-gestational-age infants (low ApoD only).
